title: When the Postcards Wakes
author: Vesper Delacroix
blurb: Noor Thornbury, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
